item.text:
**Verdict:** mostly positive, with meaningful caveats. In 2024 Lula **did appoint several competent professionals** and publicly backed technocratic autonomy, but he also **retained at least one politically connected minister after indictment** and faced credible reporting of pressure on independent institutions like Petrobras and the central bank. I found **little direct evidence of family or close-friend patronage in appointments**.

**Accepted claims**
- [Lula to nominate Galípolo as central bank chief](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764) - Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Aug 2024. Lula chose Gabriel Galípolo, then a serving central-bank monetary policy director and former finance-ministry deputy, which is strong evidence of a technocratic appointment rather than a loyalty-only pick. `7B.5`
- [Galípolo picked to run Brazil’s central bank](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/galipolo-picked-to-run-brazils-central-bank-is-heterodox-economist-3592136) - Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Aug 2024. Reuters described Galípolo as an economist with credibility built through work on Haddad’s fiscal agenda, supporting a professional-competence reading, though market skepticism was a mild caveat. `7B.5`
- [Galípolo emphasizes freedom in decision-making](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lulas-nominee-to-head-brazil-central-bank-emphasizes-freedom-in-decisionmaking-3653485) - Reuters via Investing.com, 8 Oct 2024. Galípolo told senators Lula guaranteed him freedom in decision-making, which is direct evidence that Lula at least formally empowered an expert appointee rather than treating the post as a personal office. `7B.5; 7B.3`
- [Lula says government committed to fiscal responsibility](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-says-government-is-committed-to-fiscal-responsibility-3507587) - Reuters via Investing.com, 3 Jul 2024. Haddad said Lula ordered the economic team to comply with the fiscal framework and approved spending cuts, suggesting Lula was using professional managers as real problem-solvers. `7B.5`
- [Lula says he will keep fiscal responsibility “to the letter”](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/03/responsabilidade-fiscal-e-compromisso-do-governo-e-sera-mantida-a-risca-diz-lula.htm) - Reuters via UOL, 3 Jul 2024. Lula publicly pledged rule-bound fiscal management and avoidance of economic shocks, reinforcing the technocratic side of the personnel picture. `7B.5`
- [Lula says he will choose the next central bank head carefully](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/16/ainda-nao-tenho-nome-para-presidir-bc-vou-escolher-na-hora-certa-diz-lula.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL, 16 Jul 2024. Lula said he would decide carefully and consult Haddad, which points more toward competence-based selection than casual patronage. `7B.5`
- [Regula Melhor](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12150.htm) - Presidência da República, 20 Aug 2024. The regulatory reform framework emphasizes evidence, transparency, participation, and periodic review, which is consistent with technocratic governance rather than yes-man rule. `7B.5; 7B.3`
- [Integrity in public contracts decree](https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/dia-internacional-de-combate-a-corrupcao-presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-fortalece-integridade-em-contratos-publicos) - Controladoria-Geral da União / Presidência da República, 9 Dec 2024. Lula signed a decree requiring integrity programs for large contractors and CGU monitoring, which cuts against a patronage-filled cabinet logic. `7B.5; 7B.4`
- [Lula denies interference with PF/judiciary](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/30/lula-rebate-acusacoes-de-bolsonaro-sobre-operacao-da-pf.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL, 30 Jan 2024. Lula said his government does not interfere with the Federal Police or judiciary and that the PF acted under court orders; self-serving, but directly relevant to whether he used appointments and law enforcement for personal protection. `7B.5; 7B.4; 7B.3`
- [Communications minister indicted in Codevasf probe](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm) - Reuters via UOL, 12 Jun 2024. Lula’s communications minister was indicted in a probe tied to diversion of public works resources, and Lula did not immediately remove him; this is the clearest patronage/capture signal in the 2024 cabinet. `7B.5; 7B.4`
- [Petrobras dividend interference](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL, 20 Mar 2024. Reuters reported pressure on Lula to block extraordinary Petrobras dividends and redirect funds toward investment/fiscal uses, showing political steering of a strategic state-linked firm. `7B.5; 7B.4`
- [TCU probe into Petrobras interference](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm) - Reuters via UOL, 18 Mar 2024. The TCU prosecutor asked for an investigation into possible government interference, citing concern that dividend decisions were driven by government preference rather than economics. `7B.5; 7B.4`

**Search gap**
- I found **no strong 2024 evidence** that Lula filled top posts with family members, personal friends, donors, or business associates in the narrow sense.
- The negative evidence is mainly **one politically connected minister, pressure on strategic economic institutions, and a few capture-style signals**, not a clear system-wide cronies-only cabinet.
